notes.note: Reviewed the native plugin fixture delta through real WebDriver Station selection, mounted frame relay, CSP transport observation and explicit unavailable-service responses. Product APIs, sidecar ownership, recovery, native permission grants and release provenance are unchanged. The native verification guide now distinguishes absent child bridges from observed WebView2 native-fetch CSP refusal and explicitly excludes fallback transport and exhaustive command-origin qualification. Windows debug runtime passed using the retained build; this is not an exact-final-source packaged or real-keyring receipt.
